Source [S1] notes similarly show '-sin(theta)' and '-sin(theta*zrate)' in the position calculation. These negative signs in the coordinate calculations align with the convention that the camera's local Z-axis points in the negative world direction (or that the projection involves flipping axes consistent with OpenGL), supporting the claim.
